findings.title: B2: harness->argv construction undefined
findings.description: herdr agent start <name> -- <argv...> requires the FULL harness command. [agent.runner] harness='opencode' names a harness but S3 does not define where the command comes from. Different harnesses launch differently; no harness->command registry exists, so S3 is unimplementable beyond one hardcoded harness. Also the herdr integration must be installed (herdr integration install opencode) or nothing reports status — listed nowhere as a precondition. FIX: add harness-command registry (proposed M151) + integration-installed precondition check (proposed S0/doctor).
findings.resolution: Spec remediated directly via step/AC/design-decision fragments (S0,S1,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8 + AC-01/02/03 + 3 design decisions)

findings.title: B1: completion signal wrong for interactive agents
findings.description: S5 says wait_for_done(pane) blocks until herdr reports agent-status=done. The opencode bridge (~/.config/opencode/plugins/herdr-agent-state.js) only maps session status to idle/working — it NEVER reports done. herdr wait agent-status --status done blocks forever for opencode. Even idle is ambiguous (fires every turn mid-milestone). plan.json lifecycle (mp show --fields lifecycle: approved->in-progress->self-reviewed->reviewed) is the only unambiguous completion signal. FIX: flip S5/S7 so lifecycle polling is the primary gate; demote herdr agent-status to liveness/health only. Contradicts the polling-strategy design decision which already had the right answer.
findings.resolution: Spec remediated directly via step/AC/design-decision fragments (S0,S1,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8 + AC-01/02/03 + 3 design decisions)

findings.title: B3: config file path and schema wrong
findings.description: S1 says add [agent.runner] to ProjectConfig in crates/mp-model/src/config.rs. That file has NO ProjectConfig (only domain types Decisions/Brief/Ideas). The real ProjectConfig is in crates/mp/src/config.rs with sections workflow/output/display/ui/archive/next/git/planning. Also [agent.runner] needs a command/argv field (per B2), not just harness/model/thinking_level. thinking_level is harness-specific (opencode --model vs pi flags) with no consumer defined. FIX: correct S1 path to crates/mp/src/config.rs; add command field; defer per-harness model/thinking mapping to follow-up.
findings.resolution: Spec remediated directly via step/AC/design-decision fragments (S0,S1,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8 + AC-01/02/03 + 3 design decisions)

findings.title: S4: prompt-send readiness race
findings.description: Sending a prompt before the harness has booted silently drops it. Need to gate agent send on readiness: wait agent-status --status idle (or output-match on the harness prompt) BEFORE agent send. Spec does not gate send on readiness. FIX: add S4a readiness-gate step.
findings.resolution: Spec remediated directly via step/AC/design-decision fragments (S0,S1,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8 + AC-01/02/03 + 3 design decisions)

findings.title: S8: pane reuse vs L5 session-boundary
findings.description: Pane reuse across milestones conflicts with the mp-flow L5 session-boundary discipline: the runner execution session (stages 5-7) must close before the coordinator review session (stage 8) opens in a FRESH session, and stage-8 != stage-10 (re-review) sessions. FIX: state an explicit rule that pane reuse is per-role and the review loop (8->9->10) still enforces session boundaries; do not reuse one coordinator pane across stage 8 and stage 10.
